title: [SpaceNews article] Senate defense bill backs space buildup but questions acquisition strategy
summary: Senate defense bill backs space buildup but questions acquisition strategy Senate defense bill backs space buildup but questions acquisition strategy
body_markdown:
WASHINGTON — The Senate Appropriations Committee is pushing back against the Pentagon’s reliance on large contracts awarded to individual companies for military satellite programs, proposing new restrictions and funding changes intended to preserve competition.
